## What I build (with starting prices)

### Websites — from €800
Production sites on Next.js 15 / React 19 / TypeScript / Tailwind. Multilingual (RU/EN/PL/UA) with localized URLs and hreflang. Schema.org, IndexNow, OG generation, sub-1s LCP. CMS optional (Sanity, Notion, MDX). 30 days of edits included. Typical delivery: 2–3 weeks for marketing sites, 4–6 weeks for larger projects.

### AI Agents — from €1,200
RAG assistants (knowledge-base chats with strict citation), sales bots (lead qualification, CRM integration), automations (lead pull, email classification, content generation). Models: OpenAI GPT, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini — provider-agnostic via abstraction layer. Integrations: AmoCRM, HubSpot, Pipedrive, Telegram Bot, WhatsApp via Wappi, Instagram DM, Slack. Always with a human-in-the-loop dashboard.

### Mobile apps — from €3,000
Cross-platform iOS + Android on React Native + Expo SDK 52. Authentication, payments (Stripe, RevenueCat), push notifications (Expo Push), OTA updates (EAS Update). App Store Connect and Google Play Console submission included. Typical MVP: 4–6 weeks to TestFlight / Internal Testing.

## Pricing rules

- Final price is fixed after a 30-minute discovery call. Written estimate within 24 hours.
- Edits after launch: €50/hour, 1-hour minimum. No forced monthly retainer.
- Contracts always in writing. Polish or English law.
- VAT EU invoicing available.

## Case studies (real client work)

### LegalWin (legalwin.pl)
- Industry: Immigration legal services, Warsaw
- Built: Multilingual Next.js 15 site (RU/PL/UA) with RAG AI consultant on GPT-4o
- Stack: Next.js 15, TypeScript, next-intl, RAG via pgvector, Telegram Bot API, Vercel
- Results:
  - Ranks in top-10 for 15+ commercial queries in PL ("karta pobytu Warszawa", "pobyt stały Polska")
  - AI consultant handles ~80% of first-touch client contacts
  - Displays a real 4.9★ rating from 312 clients

### VisionAir (visionair.biz.pl)
- Industry: Aerial cinematography (drone), Warsaw
- Built: Fast Next.js site with 7 SEO-optimized service verticals + instant Telegram lead pipeline
- Stack: Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, next-intl (EN/PL/RU/UK), Upstash Redis (rate-limit), Telegram Bot API, IndexNow, Vercel
- Results:
  - Sub-1s LCP across all 7 service verticals
  - Leads reach the operator on Telegram in under 2 seconds
  - New pages indexed in hours, not days
  - Visitor-to-lead conversion 4.2% (up from 0.8% on the previous site)

### CRM Bot (under NDA, B2B sales automation)
- Industry: B2B sales automation
- Built: AI agent that replaced the first-touch sales manager
- Stack: TypeScript, Node.js, Express, Gemini 2.0 Flash with function calling, AmoCRM API v4, Firestore, Wappi (WhatsApp), Telegram Bot API
- Results:
  - Lead qualification reduced from ~40 minutes to ~8 minutes
  - 100% coverage of incoming leads — none go unanswered
  - Qualified-lead conversion up 31% from process stability

## How working with me differs from an agency

- You message me directly. No account managers, no junior developers under a senior's signature. The person you brief is the person writing the code.
- Decisions take minutes, not weeks.
- Fixed scope, fixed price, fixed launch date — written before the project starts.
- Weekly demos every Friday. Course can change at any time.
- 30 days of bug-fix support included in every project.

## Common questions and exact answers

- How long does a website take? Marketing sites: 2–3 weeks. Larger sites with custom integrations or multilingual content: 4–6 weeks. The launch date is in writing before kickoff.
- Do you work in Polish? Yes — conversational Polish (B1), enough for meetings, contracts, day-to-day work. Fluent English (B2+). Native Russian and Ukrainian.
- Will the site rank on Google? Yes — that's the default, not an upsell. Technical SEO (schema, hreflang, Core Web Vitals, IndexNow on deploy) is part of every site.
- Edits after launch? €50/hour, 1-hour minimum, no forced retainer.
- Native iOS or React Native? Cross-platform via Expo / React Native for 90% of product cases. Native code only when truly needed (AR, heavy graphics, specialized hardware).
